summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB single-line obfuscated file `math_init.js` (`_0x...`-style identifiers, rotating string-array with char-code reassembly). The obfuscated payload is executed automatically at `npm install` time via the freshly-fetched alternate runtime, bypassing Node-focused inspection. The package advertises itself as an ESLint plugin authored by `ServiceTitan` with homepage `github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint`, and `lib/index.js` is a thin ESLint-plugin wrapper unrelated to the preinstall payload — the fetch-and-execute path has no connection to the advertised folder-schema linting purpose. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape (install-time execution of an opaque blob under a second language runtime) is characteristic of supply-chain compromise.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
